title: The Share of Outstanding Rider Premium the Plan Meets Out of a Withdrawn Application
content:
Out of the money returned on a withdrawn Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan application, the share of the rider premium owing that the plan meets follows the state of the member's rider under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders and whether rider premium has been charged to that rider's account at all.

1. Where the member's optional supplemental benefit rider stands suspended for unpaid rider premium and rider premium has been charged to its account, the share of the rider premium owing the plan meets is the whole of it, that is 100 per cent.
2. Where the member's optional supplemental benefit rider stands in force or in its waiting period and rider premium has been charged to its account, the share the plan meets is half of it, that is 50 per cent.
3. Where no rider premium has been charged to the member's rider account, where the rider stands in any state other than suspended for unpaid rider premium, in force or in its waiting period, or where the member holds no optional supplemental benefit rider, the share the plan meets is none of it, that is 0 per cent.

A rider account to which no rider premium has ever been charged falls under the third entry whatever state the rider itself stands in, so the share the plan meets is none of it.

*Hypothetical case.* On a rider premium owing of 96.00 USD: a rider suspended for unpaid rider premium with rider premium charged to its account gives a rider premium met of 96.00 USD; a rider in force with rider premium charged to its account gives 48.00 USD; and a rider whose account carries no rider premium charge at all gives 0.00 USD.
